name: Presynaptic calcium signaling and GABAergic inhibitory synapse assembly
rationale: Members cover presynaptic membrane potential, G-protein/Gbeta-gamma control of K+ and Ca2+ channels and vesicle release together with GABA receptor/gephyrin clustering and inhibitory synapse assembly, which the glutamatergic-focused confusables lack.

qualifier: protein import into matrix and membrane
name: Peroxisomal matrix and membrane protein import
rationale: All members concern targeting and importing proteins into the peroxisome (matrix import, receptor recycling, membrane protein import), whereas confusables cover peroxisomal fatty acid metabolism.

core: PD-L1 regulation and antitumor T cell response
name: PD-L1 transcription, turnover and antitumor T cell response
rationale: Members regulate PD-L1 transcription (incl. ALK-STAT3 nuclear events), glycosylation and proteasomal/lysosomal degradation and T cell responses to tumor; transcriptional control distinguishes it from Nef/neddylation and hepatocyte confusables.

name: Adipocyte GLUT4 translocation promoting glucose uptake
rationale: Members describe GLUT4 trafficking to the plasma membrane (with RHOQ/TC10 and protein membrane targeting), positive glucose import and adiponectin secretion, while confusables focus on insulin receptor signaling and negative regulation.

qualifier: stress granule dynamics under PKR/arsenite stress
name: AU-rich mRNA turnover and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members are ARE-binding protein mRNA stabilization/decay and translational silencing plus stress granule assembly/disassembly, PKR and arsenite response, the stress-granule part being absent from mRNA-decay confusables.

qualifier: ADA and PNP purine deoxynucleoside defects
name: Deoxyribonucleotide catabolism and ADA/PNP deficiency
rationale: Members cover deoxynucleoside/deoxynucleotide (dAMP, dGMP, dCMP, dTMP) breakdown including ADA and PNP defects, unlike confusables centred on pyrimidine synthesis or ribonucleoside purine catabolism.

name: TRKA and TRKC neurotrophin signaling through MAPK cascades
rationale: Members are NGF/TRKA and NTF3/NTRK3 activation with RAS, PI3K, PLCG1, ERK5, p38 and MAPK4/6 outputs, unlike confusables built on p75NTR death signaling or BDNF/TRKB.

name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling and PDGF receptor regulation
rationale: Members combine Hippo pathway, YAP/TAZ transcription and cell-density sensing with regulation of PDGFR-alpha/beta and FGFR signaling in mechanoresponsive fibroblasts; confusables have one half but not both.

core: Wnt ligand secretion and receptor activation
name: Wnt ligand secretion and non-canonical Wnt/calcium signaling
rationale: Members cover PORCN-dependent Wnt biogenesis and secretion, receptor-level activation and antagonism, and WNT5A/Ca2+ non-canonical signaling, distinguishing it from canonical destruction-complex and Hedgehog-lipidation confusables.

name: Fructose, glycerol and alanine entry into gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members concern fructose, glycerol/alditol, alanine and oxaloacetate metabolism feeding gluconeogenesis, unlike confusables on galactose, glycolysis, glucose-6-phosphate or pentoses.

name: CRH-driven HPA axis glucocorticoid secretion and stress behavior
rationale: Members span CRH response, corticotropin and cortisol/glucocorticoid secretion, corticosterone response and fear/adaptation behavior, whereas confusables are general behaviors or glucocorticoid receptor responses.

name: Apical-basal epithelial polarity with brush border and podocyte specialization
rationale: Members cover epithelial polarity, tight junctions, microvillus/brush border assembly and podocyte/nephrin/glomerular epithelial features, unlike confusables on adherens junctions, glomerular vasculature or apical protein sorting.

name: Replication fork stress and DNA topological processing
rationale: Members include replication initiation, fork reversal, R-loop and DNA-protein crosslink repair, DNA topological change and responses to hydroxyurea/camptothecin, versus telomere, checkpoint or transcription-termination confusables.

qualifier: dendritic cell antigen presentation, protozoan response
name: Dendritic cell IL-12 and Th1 cytokine response to protozoa
rationale: Members cover IL-12, IFN-gamma and GM-CSF production, Th1 responses, activated dendritic cells and DC antigen presentation in response to protozoa, the DC/protozoan aspect absent from Th1-differentiation and NKT confusables.

name: Adenylate cyclase-cAMP activation of CREB
rationale: All three members link adenylate cyclase-generated cAMP to CREB phosphorylation/activity, distinguishing it from PKA-only and CaMK-CREB confusables.

name: Fibroblast-to-myofibroblast differentiation and fibrotic matrix regulation
rationale: Members regulate cardiac fibroblast/myofibroblast differentiation, collagen metabolism, ECM assembly and connective tissue replacement, unlike confusables on fibroblast apoptosis/migration, TGF-beta or collagen synthesis.

qualifier: splice-isoform ligand binding and oncogenic mutants
name: FGFR isoform ligand binding, oncogenic mutants and adaptor cascades
rationale: Members are FGFR1-4 b/c isoform ligand binding, Klotho co-receptors, activating mutants and FRS/SHC/PLCgamma/PI3K cascades, which confusables (PI3K-only, Spry regulation, other RTKs) lack.

name: RHOA/B/C and CDC42-subfamily GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are RHOA, RHOB, RHOC, CDC42, RHOG and RHOJ GTPase cycles and CDC42 signaling, distinguishing it from RAC, RHOD/F and RHOU/V/RND confusables.

name: Clathrin-mediated synaptic vesicle and receptor endocytic recycling
rationale: Members cover clathrin coat assembly/disassembly, synaptic vesicle endocytosis and recycling and postsynaptic receptor internalization, unlike confusables on vesicle docking/release or Rab/ARF signaling.

qualifier: intestinal hexose absorption and renal urate handling
name: Intestinal and renal hexose, urate and amino acid transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated hexose absorption, carbohydrate digestion, urate and cystine/glycine transport and their inherited defects, the sugar and urate component distinguishing it from amino acid and organic ion transport confusables.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor signaling and chemokine production
name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven myeloid chemotaxis and chemokine production
rationale: Members cover neutrophil/monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, formyl peptide and complement receptor signaling and CCL/CXCL chemokine production, unlike confusables on degranulation, respiratory burst or extravasation.

core: Lipid droplet dynamics and triglyceride storage
name: Lipid droplet triglyceride storage and adipocyte lipid homeostasis
rationale: Members cover lipid droplet formation, fusion, disassembly and lipophagy, triglyceride storage and phospholipid regulation in adipogenesis, versus confusables on triglyceride synthesis, catabolism or fatty acid oxidation.

qualifier: PLCgamma, PI3K, RAS and STAT3 effector branches
name: TRKA and TRKC signaling through PLCgamma, PI3K and RAS
rationale: Members are NGF/TRKA and NTF3/NTRK3 activation with PLCG1, PI3K, RAS and STAT3 branches and retrograde signaling, lacking the ERK5/p38/CREB outputs or p75NTR signaling of the confusables.

name: Cerebellar motor coordination, proprioception and locomotion
rationale: Six of seven members concern posture, proprioception, walking and Purkinje layer formation (one neural RNA-binding module is an outlier), distinguishing it from glycinergic, granule-cell and vocal/exploratory behavior confusables.

name: Platelet activation via ADP P2Y receptors and GPVI
rationale: Members cover platelet activation through ADP P2Y1/P2Y12, GPVI and LDL sensitization, unlike confusables centred on thrombin/thromboxane receptors or adhesion and aggregation.
